about: Modwerk source-only wavefolder package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/wavefolder. A send effect: the site builds it on the Modwerk base's send-bus variant.

mods.title: WAVEFOLDER
mods.summary: A wavefolder on the Rytm's send bus: past full level the sound folds back in, more as you push it, and the folds follow each hit's strength.
mods.description: A wavefolder on the Rytm's send bus: past full level the sound folds back in, more as you push it, and the folds follow each hit's strength.
mods.author: stigmagit
mods.on_unit: Test build MB11, with the same source but for its effect id built locally, ran on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as the author reported; this package has not run on a unit.
